title: Bronze Rewards Card: New Customer Promo - 0% APR for the First Year
summary: This document explains the Bronze Rewards Card new-customer promo offering 0% APR on carried balances for the first 12 months from account opening. It’s available from 2025-09-01 through 2026-02-28, after which the APR on carried balances reverts to 20.49% for any remaining/new carried balances.
